pages.description: 本页面介绍Web可持续发展的重要意义，以及W3C在该领域开展的工作。
pages.text: Web可持续发展 | 我们的使命 | W3C 转到内容 Web可持续发展 技术若要实现可持续发展，必须将经济增长、社会福祉与环境保护融为一体。构建一个保护人类、地球与繁荣的可持续Web，是共建服务全人类Web的一部分。Web本是为人类而设计，但其技术却会对环境和更广泛的社会产生连锁影响。 用户担忧技术对生态造成的影响——无论是电子废弃物带来的影响，还是对发电与用电需求的增加，抑或是数据中心，再或是数字产品与服务产生的排放。各组织也比以往任何时候都更需要韧性。我们正在探讨数字产品和服务在设计、开发与运营方面如何能够减少对环境的负面影响，同时确保Web平台仍然是人们理想的空间。 我们与个人、设计师和开发者、软件和硬件厂商以及监管机构携手合作，推动多方积极参与W3C的工作，并尽己之力让Web更加可持续：一个对所有人开放、节约环境资源、支撑人与社会的Web。 W3C如何推进可持续发展 制定Web可持续发展指南 评估实施方案的可持续性影响 为创作者提供资源，助力实现Web可持续发展 协调可能影响Web未来可持续性的研发工作 支持Web可持续层面的教育与推广 与横向审阅小组协作，评估各项规范的可持续性影响 W3C可持续发展总监Tzviya Siegman阐释了数字可持续性的含义，并对《Web可持续发展指南》作了概要介绍。 可持续发展相关工作 Web可持续发展兴趣组 Web可持续发展兴趣组 的使命是提升数字可持续性，让Web更好地惠及全人类和地球。 该兴趣组的工作重点之一是制定W3C《Web可持续发展指南》及其配套的《影响评级》。小组的交付成果清单可在其 GitHub readme 上查阅。 Web可持续发展指南 W3C《Web可持续发展指南》 （Web Sustainability Guidelines简称WSG）旨在打造更有利于人类、地球和繁荣的数字产品。在实践中，这意味着减少数据、能源、处理和硬件的使用；让网站保持简洁、快速、无障碍和包容；减少浪费和不必要的第三方服务；并将可持续性纳入产品和业务决策。 WSG影响评级 W3C《Web可持续发展指南影响评级》 帮助团队了解哪些可持续性改进对人类、地球和繁荣的影响最大，以及实施这些改进的难度和耗时。每项指南均依据其潜在影响和预计实施周期进行评级，帮助组织明确优先发力方向。简而言之，它能帮助团队了解每项建议的潜在影响，并确定先着手推进哪些事项。 赞助支持 欢迎您所在的组织成为 “共享万维网”倡导者 ，该赞助机会对W3C会员和非会员均开放。 赞助此项工作 成为W3C会员，共建可持续Web W3C会员 携手 共建Web未来 。 欢迎 联系我们 ，了解 W3C会员权益 ，亲身参与其中，发挥重要作用！ Related content 欢迎参与 本页描述了个人和组织可以参与万维网联盟（W3C）工作，以推进Web标准化的方式。 页面 W3C可持续发展工作的相关新闻 筛选Web可持续发展相关新闻 新闻

pages.text: Web安全 | 我们的使命 | W3C 转到内容 Web安全 隐私和安全——作为 人权 和 公民自由 不可或缺的一部分——一直是Web联盟议程中的重要内容。例如，我们的工作在开发能够替代弱密码的身份验证技术、减少网络钓鱼和类似攻击威胁方面起到了关键作用。 然而，用户会合理地担心他们的个人数据被滥用以及在网上被追踪，包括浏览器指纹识别、虚假信息的传播和其他网络危害。这些都是困难且紧迫的挑战。我们已经开始讨论如何在不增加审查的情况下，帮助用户找到可信的Web内容。 2024年4月，Simone Onofri介绍W3C的安全标准化工作（时长00:09:46）。作为人权与公民自由的重要基石，隐私与安全始终是W3C的核心议程。在广岛召开的W3C成员会议上，Simone Onofri阐述了安全标准化战略的三大支柱：制定安全标准、建立验证机制、引导开发者构建安全可靠的web生态。 W3C如何处理安全问题 制定安全技术标准 审核Web标准的安全性 指导Web开发者以安全的方式进行设计和开发 制定安全标准 我们有几个小组专门制定安全标准。 威胁建模 威胁建模社区小组 为安全、隐私和用户权益保护专家以及技术领域专家提供了一个平台，用于创建威胁模型。这些模型是动态文档，识别跨领域的威胁和缓解措施，并提供有关剩余风险的信息。 Web应用安全 Web应用安全工作组 开发安全和策略机制，以提高Web应用的安全性，并实现安全的跨站点通信。 Web身份验证 Web身份验证工作组 定义了一个客户端API，为Web应用提供强身份验证功能。 联合身份认证 联合身份认证工作组 支持在不损害安全和隐私原则的情况下进行身份验证和授权流程。 Web支付安全 Web支付安全兴趣小组 致力于增强各种Web支付技术的安全性和互用性。 审查Web标准的安全性 安全审查由W3C团队协调的一组志愿审查员进行。我们欢迎更多人加入该团队。提出的问题使用 与PING相同的工具 进行跟踪。 我们正在组建一个小组，与安全研究人员和密码学家一起进行横向安全审查。 安全兴趣小组 (SING) 这个小组的使命是通过向制定标准的小组提供建议，指导他们如何避免和缓解技术上的安全问题，同时建议对现有标准和技术进行更改以提高安全性，从而改善Web的安全性。 指导Web开发者以安全的方式进行设计和开发 我们组建了一个跨组织小组，旨在为Web开发者提供指导并确保一种全方位的安全方法。 Web应用安全指南 Web应用安全指南（SWAG）社区小组 通过为Web开发者制定安全最佳实践，并为利益攸关方提供合作平台（例如OpenSSF、OWASP、Open Web Docs等），提高Web应用开发的整体安全性，从而使Web对用户来说更加安全。 小组正在制定 增强web应用程序安全性的开发指南 。 赞助安全标准化活动 欢迎您所在的单位成为“ W3C原则倡导者 ”；该赞助计划面向W3C成员与非成员单位开放。 赞助此项工作 成为W3C会员共建安全的Web W3C会员 在 塑造Web 的进程中发挥着重要作用。 联系W3C 以了解更多关于 W3C会员的权益 ，从而进一步发挥重要作用！

pages.title: Web标准 | W3C
pages.description: 该页面提供了对web标准的整体介绍。
pages.text: Web标准 | W3C 转到内容 Web标准 Web标准作为蓝图或构建模块被用来构建一致且和谐的数字互联世界，这些标准应用到了浏览器、博客、搜索引擎及其他支持Web体验的软件中。 Web标准的承诺 W3C标准定义了一个 开放的Web平台 用于应用开发。Web拥有前所未有的潜能，使开发者能够构建丰富的、可以在任何设备上使用的互动体验。 Web平台不断扩展，实际上Web用户早已围绕HTML这个Web基石汇聚起来。W3C及其合作伙伴创建的更多技术扩展了Web并增强了其功能，包括CSS、SVG、WOFF、WebRTC、XML及越来越多的各种API。 了解W3C标准 为什么选择W3C发布的Web标准？ W3C发布的推荐标准被视为Web标准。 W3C根据 W3C标准化流程文档 制定技术规范，该流程旨在最大限度地达成共识、确保质量，并获得 W3C会员 及更广泛社区的认可和采纳。 W3C制定的Web标准在互操作性、安全性、隐私保护、Web无障碍和国际化层面进行了优化。 W3C经过验证的Web标准化流程基于公平、开放和免版税的原则，我们致力于打造一个所有人都可以使用的Web。 了解Web标准的潜力和承诺。 在W3C创建标准的价值 自1994年以来，W3C一直为创建Web标准提供一个高效的环境： 遵循基于共识的决策流程； 满足无障碍、隐私、安全性和国际化的要求； 反映各个行业和全球利益相关者的意见； 平衡速度、公平、公众责任和质量； 受益于参与者提供的 免版税专利许可承诺 ； 保持稳定持久（W3C确保标准发布的URI持续有效）； 受益于W3C内外各团体的广泛审查； 免费提供； 通过互用性测试得到强化。 广泛的应用范围 W3C的 标准、技术规范和指南 在Web上被广泛应用： 渲染网页； 任意设备均可以访问； Web的架构； 链接的数据和服务； 创作工具。 相关内容 W3C标准和草案 本页面列出了处于各个成熟度级别的W3C所有工作组的全部标准和规范。 目录 W3C的小组 该页面列出了W3C的各类工作小组。 目录 审阅与公众反馈 对规范、实现、测试套件和代码的公众评审与反馈。 页面

pages.title: Web標準 | W3C
pages.description: このページはハイレベルでのWeb標準について紹介します
pages.text: Web標準 | W3C コンテンツへスキップ Web標準 Web標準は、一貫性があり調和のとれたデジタル接続された世界の青写真、あるいは構成要素です。ブラウザ、ブログ、検索エンジン、その他のソフトウェアに実装され、私たちのウェブ体験を支えています。 Web標準の約束 W3C 標準は、アプリケーション開発のための オープンなウェブプラットフォーム を定義しています。Webは、開発者がどのようなデバイスでも利用できるリッチなインタラクティブな経験を構築できる、前例のない可能性を秘めています。 プラットフォームは拡大し続けているが、ウェブ・ユーザーはとっくにHTMLをウェブの礎として結集しています。W3Cとそのパートナーは、CSS、SVG、WOFF、WebRTC、XML、そして増え続けるさまざまなAPIなど、ウェブを拡張し、ウェブの完全な強度を与える多くの技術を生み出しています。 W3C標準について詳しく読む なぜW3Cのウェブ標準なのか？ W3Cはウェブ標準とみなされる勧告を発表しています。 W3C は、 W3C プロセス に従って技術仕様を開発しています。このプロセスは、コンセンサスを最大化し、品質を保証し、 W3C 会員 やより広範なコミュニティによる支持と採用を得るように設計されています。 W3CのWeb標準は、相互運用性、セキュリティ、プライバシー、Webアクセシビリティ、国際化のために最適化されています。 W3C の実績あるWeb標準プロセスは、公平性、オープン性、ロイヤリティフリーに基づいており、すべての人のために Web を機能させています。 Web標準の持つ可能性と約束されたものについて学びましょう｡ W3Cで標準を作る価値 1994年以来、W3Cはウェブ標準を作成するための生産的な環境を提供してきました： 合意に基づく意思決定プロセスに従う アクセシビリティ、プライバシー、セキュリティ、国際化に対応する 多様な業界や世界中の利害関係者の意見を反映する 速度、公平性、公共の責任、品質のバランスをとる 参加者からの ロイヤリティフリーの特許ライセンスのコミットメント の恩恵を受ける 安定しており（W3Cは発行されたURIでの持続性を保証する） W3C内外のグループから広範なレビューを受ける 無料で利用可能 相互運用性テストを通じて強化される 幅広い用途 W3C 標準、技術仕様、およびガイドライン は、ウェブ上で広く展開されています： Web ページのレンダリング あらゆるデバイスからのアクセスが可能 Webのアーキテクチャ データとサービスのリンク オーサリングツール 参考 W3C の標準と草稿 このページでは、あらゆる成熟度レベルの、あらゆるW3C作業部会による、すべてのW3C標準と仕様をリストアップしています。 ディレクトリー一覧 W3CのWeb標準について このページでは、ワールド・ワイド・ウェブ・コンソーシアムでオープンなウェブ標準を作成することの価値など、W3Cのウェブ標準について詳しく説明します。 ページ レビューと公開フィードバック 仕様、実装、テスト・スイート、コードに関する公開レビューとフィードバック。 ページ 私たちの使命 W3Cとは何か、W3Cの価値観、そして、ウェブの可能性を最大限に引き出すというW3Cの使命に基づく原則についてご紹介します。 ページ

Search Twitter YouTube Facebook Instagram Flickr LinkedIn Weeds and Invasives The BLM manages 245 million acres of public lands primarily in the Western United States, including Alaska. Seventy-nine million of these acres are impacted by noxious and invasive weeds. One of the BLM's highest priorities is to promote ecosystem health and one of the greatest obstacles to achieving this goal is the rapid expansion of weeds across public lands. These invasive plants can dominate and often cause permanent damage to natural plant communities. If not eradicated or controlled, noxious weeds will continue to jeopardize the health of the public lands and to constrain the myriad activities that occur on public lands. About Weeds and Invasives The term "weed" means different things to different people. In the broadest sense, it is any plant growing where it is not wanted. Weeds can be native or non-native, invasive or non invasive, and noxious or not noxious. Learn more and review Frequently Asked Questions . Set yourself up for success If you're like many people with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes, weight loss is part of your treatment plan. It sounds so simple: eat less and move more. But if weight loss were that easy, millions of people wouldn't be struggling right now to do it. And you've probably noticed that even people who take the weight off have a hard time keeping it off. More and more studies show that people respond differently to diets. For example, some lose weight on low carb; some gain weight. The same goes for other plans. So how do you find your secret sauce for weight loss? Make sure to focus on healthy, nutritious food. pages.text: Weirdest Minor League jerseys Skip to Content Benjamin Hill travels the nation collecting stories about what makes Minor League Baseball unique. This excerpt from the Baseball Traveler newsletter, presented by Circle K, is a mere taste of the smorgasbord of delights he offers every week. Read the full newsletter here , and subscribe to his newsletter here . They took the field in those jerseys?! No corner of the sports world has prompted this incredulous query more than Minor League Baseball, whose teams regularly wear outlandish theme jerseys in addition to their regular uniforms. To be a Minor League fan is to be exposed, on a daily basis, to a cornucopia of bold colors and bolder design. Check out jerseys in the MiLB Shop Ten examples of some of the boldest –- and probably the weirdest -- can be found below, all of which debuted during the era of sartorial excess that was the 2010s. Let's take a trip down memory lane, marveling anew at these groundbreaking and bizarre Minor League jerseys. (Note: Teams are listed at their current affiliation and level of play, which may have changed since the time these jerseys were first worn.) Bacon-themed uniforms (Lehigh Valley IronPigs, Triple-A PHI, 2014) Like Dylan going electric in 1965, the IronPigs' bacon-themed duds were an epochal event that firmly delineated the start of a new era. These uniforms, featuring bacon-strip hats and jerseys with a strip of bacon underneath a "'Pigs" wordmark, planted the seed for the food-themed alternate identity craze that continues in the Minor Leagues to this day. pages.text: Welcome Baseball Fans! | U.S. Department of Labor Skip to main content Welcome Baseball Fans! If you're a fan of baseball and disability employment, you've come to the right place! At the U.S. Department of Labor's Office of Disability Employment Policy (ODEP), we work to increase success for people with disabilities in America's workplaces. This is a goal we share with our Alliance partner the Professional Baseball Athletic Trainers Society (PBATS). Over the years, ODEP and PBATS have collaborated on a number of activities, including the production of several public service announcements (PSAs) featuring former MLB players with disabilities and/or professional baseball athletic trainers from clubs around the country. Among the topics these PSAs address is the importance of helping people stay at or return to work after injury or illness and, most recently, strategies for fostering mental health-friendly workplaces. Please view and share these PSAs and explore our resources for fostering supportive workplaces, for all workers in all types of workplaces—because everyone should be in the game. Well-known marks Article 6bis of the 1967 Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property requires member countries, such as the United States, to afford certain protections to well-known marks, regardless of whether they are registered. Specifically, member countries must provide the means to refuse or cancel the registration, and prohibit the use, of a well-known mark when applied for or used by an unauthorized party for identical or similar goods, when its use or registration would likely cause confusion. Article 16.2 of the World Trade Organization Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS Agreement), which came into force in 1995, extended Article 6bis of the Paris Convention to include services. It provided that members shall take into account that a mark is well known to a relevant sector of the public (not necessarily the entire country, or only consumers of the specific products) and the promotion of the mark (not just its use). Wellbore Construction and Evaluation Wellbores are a critical component of the infrastructure and success of geothermal electricity generation projects and represent a significant hurdle for developers. Improving the durability and costs of wellbore structures and ensuring long-term well flow are vital to reduce costs and ensure safe, efficient operation of geothermal power plants. The Office of Geothermal is funding projects that can support these needs for both next-generation and conventional geothermal systems. By improving ways to build, assess, and maintain geothermal wellbores, these projects will expand opportunities to tap firm, flexible, domestic geothermal energy nationwide. Wells of Opportunity A key step to unlocking the full potential of reliable, domestic geothermal energy may lie inside millions of American oil and gas wells . These wells can be used to harness geothermal energy in two ways: through the retrofitting of inactive or unproductive wells, or through co-production on active wells. Well Retrofits In well retrofits, an unused, dry, or unproductive oil and gas well first undergoes any repairs necessary for safe operation. Water is then pumped into the oil and gas well, where it is warmed by the earth and drawn back to the surface to power a thermoelectric generator. The hot water pulled to the surface can be used for heating, cooling, or to power nearby structures and homes. America has millions of dry or unproductive oil and gas wells, many of which could be retrofitted for geothermal use. Note: The scope of the Office of Geothermal’s WOO initiative specifically targets inactive or unproductive wells. These wells may include those that qualify as abandoned according to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency : wells that have been plugged to prevent migration of gas or fluids, wells with no recent production that are not plugged, and wells with no recent production and no responsible operator

When ancient humans interbred, new research shows that the pairings were predominantly male Neanderthals and female Homo sapiens. Reconstruction of a Neanderthal man (Homo neanderthalensis), based on the La Chapelle-aux-Saints fossils. Daynes/Science Photo Library By Annie Roth Published February 26, 2026 Neanderthal men may have had a thing for modern human women, or perhaps Neanderthal men had something human women couldn't resist. That’s one potential interpretation of a new study, published Thursday in Science , that found when Neanderthals and Homo sapiens interbred, the pairings were predominantly between Neanderthal men and human women. Scientists have long known that some of our ancestors reproduced with Neanderthals before the species went extinct roughly 40,000 years ago. Today, traces of Neanderthal DNA linger in the genomes of many people, particularly among those with non-African ancestry. On average, it amounts to about one to two percent of a person’s genome. Over the next four decades, the print workshop provided space for both Native American and non-Native artists to produce lithographs of the American West. pages.description: Discover the origin story for an accessory being comfortably lugged by nearly every hiker and student, with about 450 million sold each year
pages.text: We’ve Been Strapping Cargo to Our Backs for Millions of Years, but Backpack Innovation Really Took Off Around the Civil War Skip to main content Illustration by Emily Lankiewicz / Images via public domain Humans have been carting things on our backs in wraps of some kind at least since we began using tools, around two million years ago—and we have always sought ways to make the load more comfortable. The oldest known backpack ever discovered, in the Alps on the border between Austria and Italy, employed two narrow wooden boards and a hazel rod for a frame. The contraption dates to around 3300 B.C. and is credited to Ötzi the Iceman , a glacier mummy unearthed alongside it in 1991. But what we recognize as a backpack is much newer. In 1865, Henry Clay Merriam led a regiment of Black Union troops in an attack against Fort Blakely, a Confederate stronghold in Alabama. His deeds in this final battle of the Civil War earned him a Medal of Honor “for conspicuous gallantry.” Afterward, the lieutenant colonel had an epiphany: It was burdensome to carry both a knapsack (a pack with shoulder straps but no frame for internal support) and a haversack (a shoulder bag containing his rations). Based on his time carrying gear for the Army, Merriam devised a solution: a boxy canvas pack with room for socks, a quart of water, a shaving kit and a deck of cards, plus a compartment for rations in a case at the bottom. Inspired by the angular shapes and intersecting lines of the Cubist movement, the artist incorporated the natural patterns and grains of assorted woods into his pieces to emphasize their strong geometric and organic forms. Born in Philadelphia in 1887, Esherick studied painting at the Pennsylvania Academy of the Fine Arts from 1908–10, and discovered wood as a medium for artistic expression when he began to make carved frames for his canvases. By the mid-1920s he was fully committed to sculpture and extended his definition of the medium to the carving of furniture and architectural interiors. What accounts for the differences in the PCE price index and the Consumer Price Index? National Table 9.1U - Comparison of the PCE Price Index with the CPI reconciles the changes in the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) chain-type price index, prepared by the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA), with changes in the consumer price index for all urban consumers (CPI), prepared by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). The differences between the two indexes can be grouped into four categories: formula effect, weight effect, scope effect, and "other effects." The formula effect accounts for the different formulas used to calculate the two indexes. The PCE price index is based on the Fisher-Ideal formula, while the CPI is based on a modified Laspeyres formula. The weight effect accounts for the relative importance of the underlying commodities reflected in the construction of the two indexes. The scope effect accounts for conceptual differences between the two indexes. PCE measures spending by and on behalf of the personal sector, which includes both households and nonprofit institutions serving households; the CPI measures out-of-pocket spending by households. The "net" scope effect adjusts for CPI items out-of-scope of the PCE price index less items in the PCE price index that are out-of-scope of the CPI.

As Alzheimer's blood tests become more widely available, more people without memory problems are seeking them out. But doctors are still working to understand what the results mean for a person's future health. By Lori Youmshajekian Published October 21, 2026 A simple blood test can now hint at whether the proteins characteristic of Alzheimer’s disease are accumulating in the brain, often years before any signs of cognitive decline. But for someone who feels perfectly fine, the result may raise more questions than it answers. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has cleared four blood tests to detect signs of changes associated with the disease. Two, Elecsys pTau217 and PrecivityAD2 , were cleared in August. pages.text: What Apollo 11 astronauts actually said when they got to the moon | National Geographic Premium HISTORY & CULTURE FROM THE VAULT What Apollo 11 astronauts actually said when they got to the moon Rediscover the famous words exchanged between astronauts Buzz Aldrin, Neil Armstrong, and Michael Collins during the first moon landing and see the historic photos they took. At dawn of a two-week lunar day, Edwin Aldrin strides across a small crater near one of Eagle's foil-wrapped landing probes. Visor reflects his long black shadow, the solar wind collector, the Stars and Stripes planted by the moonwalkers, the white figure of Armstrong (who took this picture), and the buglike lunar module. A few hours earlier the two men had flashed the words that thrilled a waiting world: "Tranquillity Base here. The Eagle has landed." While Armstrong and Aldrin explore the surface, Michael Collins keeps lonely vigil in Columbia , Apollo 11's command module orbiting the moon. Feedback Summarize this article for me Many Azure regions provide availability zones , which are separated groups of datacenters within a region. Each availability zone has independent power, cooling, and networking infrastructure, so that if one zone experiences an outage, then regional services, capacity, and high availability are supported by the remaining zones. Some Azure services automatically use multiple zones, while others require you to configure multiple-zone deployment. Availability zones don't only protect against large-scale outages that affect an entire zone. They also provide resilience against smaller-scoped failures, such as a server rack or cluster failure within a zone.
